lockup.summary: Officers, directors and some shareholders agreed not to sell for 180 days, per the detailed section. The offering summary says three months, so the filing is inconsistent. The lead underwriter may waive the lock-up at its discretion.

what: Speed Group runs an e-commerce logistics business in Hong Kong, shipping small parcels to Europe and North America.
proceeds: It plans to put 30% toward market expansion and marketing, 20% toward technology, and 15% toward warehousing and distribution. The rest is for general business needs and working capital.
risks: Natural disasters, wars and similar events could disrupt airports, ports and trade, and hurt the business.
Outbreaks of contagious disease could cause health crises that damage the economy and the company's business.
It usually has no long-term contracts with customers, so its freight forwarding revenue may not stay steady.
Hong Kong may not keep its position as a logistics hub in Asia.
